# @three-ws/shipfeed

> Turn a repo's raw commit history into a release feed humans actually read: conventional-commit parsing, audience classification, and changelog-to-commit provenance with no extra metadata.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/shipfeed
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/shipfeed/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/shipfeed
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/shipfeed/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/shipfeed/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/shipfeed/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/shipfeed/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/shipfeed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
